reasons_positive.sentence_en: Stock purchases are growing compared with the previous three months.

reasons_positive.sentence_en: Past payments were made close to the due date.

reasons_positive.sentence_en: The shop buys steadily from familiar suppliers.

reasons_negative.sentence_en: Returns are higher than similar shops; this may reflect delivery conditions.
